explanation: Retrospective detector of the second token of a few tight two-word units: a pronominal/counted quantity word right after a determiner, quantifier or 'have' ('the two', 'the three', 'one more', 'some more', 'anything more/less', 'another one', 'have one', 'which one') and an addressee/politeness token after a give/thank/request verb ('give you/us', 'thank you', 'thanks for', 'Can you please'), each at ~0.5-0.8 of max; also the final suffix subword of a word the tokenizer splits into stem + suffix ('Efferves|cent', 'Fires|ide', 'pharmac|ist', 'prot|racted', 'unwield|y', ~0.45-1.0). The same words outside these pairings stay below ~0.25 of max: 'two' without 'the' ('included two approaches'), 'more' after 'much', 'many', 'no', 'even', 'far' or a verb ('wanted more time'), 'you' after 'tell'/'Can' alone, single-token words such as 'tourist', 'dentist', and ordinary content words and plain narrative ('The cat sat on the mat').
